[[File:SIM_Ark.jpg|thumb|A Starhunter menagerie ark.]]
'''Starhunter menagerie arks''' were large [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] designed to carry cargoes of multiple [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals&mdash;or even [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings being treated as such.

==History==
One early [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of this type was the ''[[Starhunter Dhelba]]'', which crashed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] about [[800 BBY/Legends|800 BBY]], introducing [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]]s, [[Gupin/Legends|Gupins]], and [[Choreamnos|tree goats]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref>{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref> Another ship of this type was used by the [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref>{{DroidsCite|Coby and the Starhunters}}</ref>
